notes.title: Demo Update v0.8.109
notes.notes:
Update v0.8.109 is now live, with a whole bunch of balance changes thanks to all the incredible feedback that has been given here, on Itch and via the in-game options - literally everything in this patch is in response to one or more comments so a huge thanks to everyone who has been in touch, it's really helping me shape the game into something that can be hopefully be enjoyed by anyone, pinball enthusiast or not.  These changes are primarily focused on being more beginner friendly while  keeping it challenging for those playing on higher difficulties. As always, please let me know what you think!
[p align="start"]v0.8.107 Patch Notes:

All Blockers are now reset when starting a new ball

Blocker HP reduced to 10 hits (was 15)

On Expert difficulties and above, this is reduced further to only 6 hits

Menu navigation can now be done using arrow keys or left/right ctrl, with spacebar or enter to confirm

Added Slow-motion effect on exiting the Shop, giving a bit more time to get your bearings.

New Blessing: Bubble Blockers: Blockers gain a protective bubble, that respawns 15s after being hit

Increased Boss tentacle respawn timer on lower levels. 

Each time a Boss tentacle is hit, it's respawn timer will increase.

Blessings rebalanced to be more impactful (-4 ritual mission count instead of -2 for each type)

Curses rebalanced to be more impactful

Reduced damage from Chain Lightning effect

Bumper HP increased at higher levels (eg Act VI is now 1,000,000 on Easy difficulty, it was 250,000)

When skipping the tutorial, all other popups will now be skipped

Some minor Glyph rebalancing

Minor bug fixes
[p align="start"]Happy Flipping!
[p align="start"] Kenny

notes.title: Massive Update: Blessings, Sparks, Burn and more
notes.notes:
It has been a crazy week due to being a part the Tiny Teams 2025 Steam festival alongside a huge uptick in players on Itch.io, so first a massive thank you to everyone who has checked the game out so far! And now I'm happy to announce v0.8.87 of the demo with a whole bunch of fixes and changes but one core new feature I've been working on for a while:

Blessings! Blessings are a huge bonus you can select at the end of every Act! There are 12 to choose from in the demo so far but there will be 32 in the final game, and I'll update the demo to 24 once they've been playtested a bit more. Obviously, this has massively changed the game balance to the point where it might now be a bit too easy on lower difficulties, but I'll see how it feels for a while before tweaking anything to compensate. Some of these were previously purchasable Glyphs, which I've not removed and replaced with new ones so there are still 40 to unlock in the demo.

Currently, the Blessings you can choose from are:

Reduce the mission count for a specific ritual by 2 (4 Blessings, one for each Multiball, Tempest, Inferno and Sparks)

Chain lightning effect between all active balls

Double Blocker HP

Increase Mana reward at the end of each Act

Rerolls in the shop start at 0

Reduce Glyph prices by 50%

Increase maximum Glyph count by 2

Duplicate Glyphs now appear in the shop (good for very specific builds)

Additionally, I felt the Sparks Ritual was a bit underwhelming, and often found it was hard to reach that one last bumper in a stage so I reworked it into dealing high damage to the nearest bumper of each actie ball, which has made it feel much, much more fun to play and when combined with Multiball, absolutely shreds bumpers. Also in this patch is the addition of a Burning mechanic, triggered by the Inferno Ritual and the Pyro ball, where targets take additional damage over time. Overall, much more destruction to be had. 

Here's the full patch notes for v0.8.87:

Blessings system added

Sparks Ritual reworked to be much more effective (and fun)

Burning feature for Inferno and Pyro ball, dealing damage over time

All Blocker Reset Glyphs no longer take up a Glyph slot (they're just destroyed on use)

All Blocker Reset Glyphs now display the blocker HP as a % in the description

Cheater Ball now grants a spare ball at the end of every Act. Survivability maxed out.

Some Glyphs added, others removed. Play to see the full changes.

Boss Bumper HP is now shown at the top of the screen when it's active

Performance imporvements throughout

Minor bug and text fixes

Overall, I feel this is a definitive shift in the game and one I hope makes it altogether a much more enjoyaable experience. While the Demo is still capped at 6 Acts, the full game will have an Endless mode - last night I managed to get my fist e-number damage alongside a Sparks and Multiball combo and it just felt insane. I hope everyone else will enjoy it as much as I do!

Happy Flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: Demo Hotfix Patch (v0.8.39)
notes.notes:
So, it turns out I'd left a development save file in the previous builds, that meant the game skipped the tutorial and had a handful of glyphs already unlocked. This meant no explaination of all the weird mechanics, so kudos to those that played without it and somehow still grasped what the heck was going on, and big thanks to the users who reported the issue.

I've patched this now with an updated save mechanic that will also allow for saves to persist between versions. While saves will be reset when the game goes into full launch, this will at least mean not having to unlock everything multiple times from now on. There are also a couple of minor fixes for missions triggering, but beyond that, this is just a patch to fix the saves.

Apologies to anyone who has played the recent builds, please go check out the new build as it should hopefully make it a whole lot less confusing... I hope.

Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: Pin Demo v0.7.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Another small patch this week with some QoL upgrades, balance changes and bug fixes!

v0.7.1 

Features and Balance changes

- Duplicate Table Traits no longer appear in the same run
- Added a cycling 'To-Do' list on main menu to show all remaining achievements 
- Pryo and Watermelon Balls changed to boost damage and $ when hitting an active Bumper
- Blocker HP now scales off of your current Damage
- The Shop will always offer a Base Blocker perk if you don't currently have one active
- The Shop will always offer an Invert Flippers perk if the relevant Table Trait is active
- Rebalanced Bumper HP at varying stages
- Chances of all blocking effects from Table Traits reduced to 1 in 3 (was 1 in 2)
- $ Rewards for completing a stage reduced 
- Redesigned Bonus Tables to offer better rewards

Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug where the Bonus Block trait had a 100% chance of blocking Bonus item effects
- Fixed a number of perks that either displayed incorrectly or whose functionality wasn't working as intended
- Fixed issues with Damage per Score perks not being correctly calculated
- Fixed a  number of issues with the Achivement Unlocked panel when returning from a run
- Fixed a number of scenarios where the Slow-Mo effect wasn't triggering when it was meant to

Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: PiN Demo Update - v0.6.22
notes.notes:
​Another week, another patch! As always, massive thank you to those who have been reporting bugs, providing feedback etc. Please, please keep it coming!  

v0.6.23

- Major Change: Table Traits are now permanent, with an additional Trait applied every 4 Stages (every 2 on Expert+ Difficulties)
- Better visual clarity around Bonus Table and Rampage activation triggers
- Show remaining Achivements on Main Menu screen
- Shop will always show a Reset Base Bumper Perk if when you don't have one (dissapears on refresh)
- Shop will always show an Invert Flippers Perk when the Invert Flipper Table Trait is active 
- Balance pass on multiple Table Traits and Perks
- Reduced $ earned per stage to 8
- Reduced costs of Rare and Legendary Perks, as well as all Perk Traits.
- Text fixes throughout
​
Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: Pin Demo v0.6.12 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has played PiN so far, the feedback continues to be absolutely invaluable and a huge encouragement so please, keep it coming!

I've tried to address as much as I can in this patch, alongside a number of balance and visual changes that I've made recently while working on the core game, here's the summary:

v0.6.12

- All Difficulties now unlockable in Demo
- Fixed a bug after showing an achievement on the main menu where the game would become uninteractible
- Fixed a bug where the camera would stick on the bonus table when multiball was active on the main table
- Visual Clarity added around Table Traits and any currently active effect
- Bonus Table layout now changes each time it is activated
- Watermelon and Pyro ball effects changed to add 1$ and 1 Damage (respectively) each time an active bumper is hit
- Various Perks rebalanced

Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: Demo v0.6.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you all for your feedback and bug reports so far, without these I really am creating in a vacuum so please, keep them coming!

That said, I'm happy to announce v0.6.2 is now live with the following changes:

- Blockers now have higher HP on all stages
- Nudge Save feature added when on Easy difficulty: a Slow Motion effect that triggers when the ball can be saved from the drain with a well-timed nudge. 
- 3 new Bonus Tables, picked at random at the start of a run. 
- Balance changes to Bumper HP on later stages
- Better physics detection, meaning fewer balls flying off the table
- Text fixes to provide clarity around some features
- Basic localization for all supprted languages
- Fix for a bug leading to players getting stuck on the bonus table

Thanks again for playing and happy flipping!!

Kenny
